messages:
Alex: Dropping weights for ceres-13b (v1) to s3://models/ceres/13b/v1. Quick readiness ping: tokenizer seems to emit a leading 'Ġ' token sometimes when decoding; config has license=CC-BY-NC-4.0. Can we confirm (1) weights path integrity, (2) tokenizer sanity, (3) whether license is ok for hosted? cc @Rachel @Miguel @Sara @LegalBot
Rachel: Thanks — can you paste the exact weights + model config? Also, image of model card?
Alex: Here: 
```
weights_path: s3://models/ceres/13b/v1/weights.pt
tokenizer: bytebpe
vocab: 50257
license: CC-BY-NC-4.0
quantized: false
```
Miguel: I'll run import validation. Quick note: if quantized later we need a q8 compatible artifact. Running: 
```
infra import-model --name ceres-13b --from s3://models/ceres/13b/v1 --profile staging
```
Expect ~5-10m. Will report errors here.
Sara: Tokenizer quirk: looks like this model uses bpe but trained with leading-space normalization, so tokens like 'Ġthe' appear when using gpt2-style tokenizers. Try this snippet to inspect:
```
from tokenizers import Tokenizer
t = Tokenizer.from_file('tokenizer.json')
print(t.encode(' the').tokens)
```
If you see leading whitespace tokens, we should set tokenizer.pad_left=false in serving config.
LegalBot: AUTOMATED CHECKLIST
- license: CC-BY-NC-4.0 -> RESTRICTED (non-commercial) ✅
- attribution required -> YES ✅
- patent/third-party weights -> unknown ❗ (please confirm source)
Notes: CC-BY-NC prohibits hosting on default public hosted plans. Allowed: Dedicated, Private. Add explicit attribution text to model card and add 'nc_restriction' flag in metadata.
Kevin: Agree with LegalBot. Product note: mark model.catalog.visibility = "private_only" (unless legal clears). Also add attribution string, e.g. "Ceres-13B (CeresAI)" and include 'usage_restrictions' field.
Miguel: Import finished in staging: checksum mismatch on shard 3 -> reuploading shard. Staging serve started once reupload done. No runtime errors besides tokenizer tokens showing as Sara described. I'll leave it in staging until license decision.
Alex: Re-upload done, thanks. Can someone add the attribution line to the model card and set metadata flags? I'm going to hold on promoting until legal signs off.
Rachel: I'll update model-card.md in the repo: add attribution + usage_restrictions. PR coming.
LegalBot: Update: flagged 'nc_restriction' true in model registry. Please don't promote to hosted until legal approves final source attribution. If weights are third-party, we need provenance proof.
ingest-bot: ingest job 1902456795 completed -> model metadata created (status: review_pending).
Sara: I tested tokenization with the snippet, fixed serving config to set pad_left=false and added decode postproc to strip leading spaces; small perf hit ~1% latency. Deployed change to staging.
Miguel: Staging smoke tests passed (LLM generation, kv cache warm). No OOMs.
Alex: Great — thanks everyone. Leaving this thread open for legal final signoff. :thumbsup:
Kevin: Noted, will push note to product backlog to block promoted model until legal clears. :lock:
LegalBot: Waiting on 'provenance_doc' upload from Alex or contributor. Reminder: include model card clause with explicit attribution copy.
Alex: Uploading provenance now to s3://legal-proofs/ceres-13b/provenance.pdf
LegalBot: Received. Assigned to Legal team for manual review. ETA 48h.
Rachel: PR #482 updated with attribution, usage_restrictions. Link: https://git.internal/redwood/models/ceres13b/pull/482
Miguel: When legal approves, can we auto-promote to dedicated only? I can wire that rule: if nc_restriction true -> deprecate hosted route.
Kevin: Yes, please add a catalog flag 'allowed_environments': ["dedicated","private"] and block 'hosted'.
Alex: Noted. Thanks all — closing when LegalBot posts final OK.
